Maya (CS): Shorehaven day 3 check-in: where are we on VPC peering, IAM role narrowdown, KMS key access, and audit log ingestion?
Alejandro (NetEng): VPC peering complete; propagated routes. Waiting on Shorehaven firewall to add inbound for our health IPs (10.11.12.34/32).
Jenn (Sec): IAM: they sent an admin-like role. Asked them to change to least-priv; proposed S3:GetObject/PutObject on shorehaven-audit only and CloudTrail:LookupEvents for support.
Samir (Observability): Audit ingest: CloudTrail enabled but S3 delivery failing 403 from our SIEM forwarder. Suspect bucket policy or lifecycle tags.
Alejandro (NetEng): Told them NAT gateway must allow egress to our collector and to include aws:SourceIp condition. Shared minimal trust policy snippet.
Jenn (Sec): They attempted assume-role and hit: `AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole`. Likely missing trust or ExternalId mismatch.
Alejandro (NetEng): Posting trust snippet for them to paste:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-priv-agent"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"sts:ExternalId":"shorehaven-987"}}}]}
```
Samir (Observability): Example reproduce command: `aws s3 cp s3://shorehaven-audit/test.log ./ --profile shorehaven` -> 403. I'll prepare a short checklist for SIEM forwarding and a reproducible test.
infra-bot: Terraform apply completed by alejandro@redwood. 5 resources added.
Maya (CS): Blockers: 1) firewall whitelist delay, 2) security lead not yet accepting scoped IAM role. Both increase renewal risk if unresolved >7d (their eval credits end in 12d).
Jenn (Sec): Suggest 30m enablement call with their Sec+Infra to walk trust policy, bucket policy, and KMS key policy. Propose Thu 10am PT.
Alejandro (NetEng): I'll bring network diagram and route/NAT diffs.
Samir (Observability): I'll bring logs flow and the 403 test steps.
Maya (CS): Actions:
- Maya: schedule Thu 10am PT enablement + invite Shorehaven sec/infra
- Alejandro: prep trust policy & network diagram (Wed EOD)
- Jenn: draft least-priv role + S3 bucket policy example (Wed EOD)
- Samir: SIEM checklist + 403 repro steps (Wed EOD)
- Shorehaven: whitelist 10.11.12.34/32 and accept role change
Maya (CS): Shorehaven ops replied: "Adding rule now, will confirm in ~20m." Please update here when whitelist lands so Samir can re-run ingest. If enablement missed, I'll warn AM to flag renewal risk. :thumbsup:
